title: ICP Panel Verdict
_doc: Every panel answer must serialize to this shape and pass references/validate_verdict.py. The citation requirement is enforced mechanically: a verdict whose quote_keys do not resolve to real rows in data/corpus.json is rejected by the validator, not merely discouraged by a prompt. NOTE: this gate proves the evidence EXISTS and was RETRIEVED. It does not prove the inference drawn from it is sound. That is what the backtest is for.

seat._doc: Must be a seat key from references/seats.json; validate_verdict.py checks it.

corpus_version._doc: Copied verbatim from data/corpus.json. Pins the answer to a corpus state so a changed verdict can be traced to a changed corpus.

precision_level._doc: Which dimensions survived widening, e.g. 'persona+stage' or 'stage only (persona dropped, n=3)'.

source_mix._doc: Counts by source_type in the evidence pack. Guards against current-client language quietly dominating a pre-sale seat as client calls accumulate.

age_mix._doc: Dated vs undated evidence, oldest/newest, median age, share within 12 months, and a STALE flag above a 540-day median. Surfaced, never used to silently discard.

oneOf._doc: REQUIRED to be null when density_band is 'insufficient'. The seat has no standing to answer.

citations._doc: quote_keys. Must resolve against data/corpus.json AND must have been present in the retrieved evidence pack.

strongest_objection._doc: FORCED DISSENT. Mandatory on every verdict, including favourable ones. Asking an LLM 'does this resonate?' has a polite answer; this field has no polite answer. If the evidence genuinely contains no objection, say so explicitly in text and cite the nearest friction quote. Do not leave it empty.

stopped_reading_at._doc: Required for any judgment on a written asset (article, email, page). The exact line or moment this seat would disengage, or null with a stated reason if it would read to the end.

unresolved_questions._doc: The navigation use case, scoped honestly. Informational needs this seat carries INTO the page, ranked by evidence density, never a simulated click path. Each item carries its own citations.
